title: Spectrum3
tagline: NFT powered community tool using which developers can build communities easily.
description:
Spectrum3, allows users to build NFT powered community using APIs, powered by Polybase. We provide 4 modules:
- Community module
- Access module
- Airdrop module
- Ranking module

Every contribution stays in blockchain making it transparent.
